products.name: Solution Optimization — Endpoint Security with Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Make a working Endpoint Security with Microsoft Intune deployment better — reduce noise, expand coverage, and harden policy without breaking what works.
products.description:
Make a working Endpoint Security with Microsoft Intune deployment better — reduce noise, expand coverage, and harden policy without breaking what works.

A deployed product drifts: alerts get noisy, coverage lags new assets, and policies fall behind best practice. This optimization tunes an existing Endpoint Security with Microsoft Intune: tune Intune endpoint security baselines & compliance; reduce policy conflicts; expand coverage; align to security best practice — pilot-first, measured, and reversible, so you improve signal and coverage without disruption.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • tune Intune endpoint security baselines & compliance
  • reduce policy conflicts
  • expand coverage
  • align to security best practice
  • Pilot-first, measured, reversible tuning

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A tuned Endpoint Security with Microsoft Intune with less noise, broader coverage, and hardened policy — measurably better, without breaking production.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SOPEIS-ConflictReport.ps1 — report devices/settings in Conflict or Error and the policies
    • SOPEIS-Discovery.ps1 — read-only discovery of an existing Intune endpoint-security estate:
    • SOPEIS-Report.ps1 — before/after metrics for the tuning engagement: conflict/error counts,
    • SOPEIS-Set-Assignment.ps1 — add a group assignment to an endpoint-security policy to expand
    • SOPEIS-Validate.ps1 — confirm the tuning applied: latest baseline on the pilot ring, conflicts

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
